businesses.business: electrical and mechanical construction and facilities services

offering_description.value: Provides electrical and mechanical construction, installation and maintenance services, plus building and industrial services, to commercial, industrial, institutional and utility customers. Work is done by its own skilled trades on project and service-contract bases.

primary_services.value: electrical construction; mechanical construction and HVAC; building services and maintenance; industrial services such as refinery turnarounds; prefabrication and energy services

customer_segment.value: B2B: data center operators, manufacturers, commercial building owners, healthcare systems, hospitality, refineries and utilities; B2G: federal, state and local government facilities, schools and public institutions

end_markets.value: data centers; commercial buildings; healthcare; manufacturing and life sciences; institutional; oil, gas and chemical

revenue_model.value: project or contract: fixed-price and cost-plus construction projects for electrical and mechanical systems; service fees: recurring maintenance, repair and facilities service contracts, time-and-materials work

value_chain_position.value: service provider: buys materials and equipment and uses skilled labor and subcontractors to build and maintain building systems for owners and general contractors

geography_served.value: North America: United States as the main market, plus the United Kingdom and Canada

specialization.value: related lines: electrical construction, mechanical construction, building services and industrial services sharing customers and trades

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: bids and negotiated contracts with owners, general contractors and facility managers; own locations: network of local branch offices and fabrication shops serving regional customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: contractor licensing, electrical and building codes, OSHA safety, environmental rules and government contracting requirements

notes: Mix of segment shares and UK/Canada presence from memory; may have shifted.
